description: Untrusted unlock (credential-protection §5.1): both halves of master_hash, derived on the surface from the passphrase and kept nowhere, padded base64. On success, 204 and this login holds an unlock under the vault lock, replacing any it held (DEFAULT 69); the core answers no credential. A wrong passphrase is 409 unlock_failed, counted per principal, with attempts_remaining; a body missing a half is 422. Every value is a synthetic constant, so only the core's own tests grade it.
